description: MUTATES Parabol data: create a task on a team. Required: teamId and status (active|stuck|done|future). Provide `plaintextContent` for the task text (and/or `content`, which is a stringified TipTap/ProseMirror JSON document). Optionally assign to a userId or link to a meetingId/discussionId. Parabol GraphQL: createTask(newTask, area). Requires TASKS_WRITE.

area.description: Optional AreaEnum context for the task (e.g. 'teamDash', 'meeting').

content.description: Rich-text content as a stringified TipTap/ProseMirror JSON document.

discussionId.description: Link the task to this discussion id (meeting thread).

fields.description: Additional documented GraphQL input fields to send verbatim in this mutation's input (merged OVER the typed fields above).

meetingId.description: Link the task to this meeting id.

teamId.description: The team id to create the task on (required).

userId.description: Assign the task to this user id.

name: create_task
title: Create a task
